fast_core_mode.description: Compute the governed core forecasting surface only; skip research-only expansion blocks.

full_research_mode.description: Backward-compatible full feature surface, including compatibility aliases and delta expansion.

regime_risk_mode.description: Compute core plus regime/risk context without research-only delta or compatibility aliases.

price_reference_semantics.notes: The model always references the current close column via model_close_reference. raw_close is only populated when the upstream source is not explicitly adjusted. adjusted_close is only materialized when price_adjustment_status=adjusted. Corporate-action diagnostics remain active when the series is raw because live vnstock_data adjusted closes are not available in the active quote path.

market_regime.logic: bull when close > sma_20, sma_20 > sma_50, and close_return_20d > 0; bear when the inverse holds; otherwise sideways.

regime_definitions.persistence: Current consecutive-day streak length within the same regime label.
regime_definitions.transition: 1 when the current regime label differs from the previous trading day, else 0.

trend_regime.logic: uptrend when trend_regime_strength > 0.5 and close > sma_200; downtrend when trend_regime_strength < -0.5 and close < sma_200; otherwise neutral.

volatility_regime.logic: high when rolling_volatility_20 > 1.25 * trailing 60-day median; low when < 0.75 * trailing 60-day median; otherwise normal.
